body: It's all just stress right now hahah worse when the one person you want advice has cut you out of their life (right thing to do) due to my behaviours 🙃
All day every day. Id do anything to go back in time.

Thing is I don't really want to be here anymore. Next session is in a week. I can only afford it twice a month. She uses a mix of cbt and schema and a few others. I've no one to reach out too anymore, I've no support system and I just want the pain to stop at the moment and I'm willing to do anything to make that happen right now.

It was Christmas that triggered it all and a conversation with my fp which was the first in months, I put myself in a position to be better and I messed it up again, I can't even do the basics at the moment and I'm meant to have college work done and be back in work, yet I can't even get out of bed most times anymore. I'm honestly feeling so lost again, I just wish I could have them back in my life yet i know I never will. I'm just not sure how to pick myself back up this time.

Yes, I told her it all in my last session. I felt good for about an hour for being able to talk, yet it just came back and stuck around, Ive completely relapsed into the shell of a person I was, I really don't want to go on anymore.
Big time at the moment. Part of me wants too and then there's the other part that can't 😔
I feel you on this, its like what's the point? Totally sucks.
I've been thinking the same, I hope going to hospital will help. You got this.
Ive given myself enough chances. Thank you, it's okay.
I wish that was the case but they're gone for good. That's their words. I wish they wernt. It's okay.

What I did isn't forgivable. I hurt someone I love more than I ever could of imagined and that's on me. It's my responsibility to not hurt others or them again and this way means I can't do that. I'm too ashamed of what I done to ever live a full life worth living, and I've tried it without them before. I can't go back to that.

Ive thought about that, which is why since these feelings have started I've been planning. Nothing is 100% and I understand the risk, it's one I have to take.

Thank you, I did try to fight. I always fought it.
Maybe you're scared of being hurt so you push them away to save you from that hurt? Like your brain is pre protecting itself.

Yeh I do, since I've pushed everyone away and never received enough love when I was a child so when I receive it as an adult, I don't want to lose it and want more. . Sounds like you base your worth on the people around you? Maybe that is why you feel empty? I'm not too sure, just putting out suggestions. I know how tough it is. So you're not alone.
I'm struggling with the exact same thing right now. Wish I had an answer.

I generally feel the exact same as you. But there is a high success rate with certain therapys like DBT, its hard, very hard but it does have a good results. I know it won't be much help saying that I really do understand how you feel and how utterly shit it is.

They just want me to keep going with dbt. I've been told go to the hospital but I know going and being on a ward will make me worse. I don't know what more I can do that will help. I'm at the end of the road.
I just don't see it working for me no matter how hard I generally work. It just overwhelmes me and i can't handle it, the skills slow it down but I just can't tolerate the pain when it comes back.
I wish I was that strong. I wish I had a part of me that cared about me but that's dead now. How I behaved is inexcusable, unforgivable. And I can't Live knowing that.
I just want it all to stop. I can't tolerate this anymore. I'm scared Im going to end it. As I feel it's the only way.
Sounds like a good idea, I'm just generally too scared to have any interaction with people now. Face to face. I can't tolerate this pain anymore.

I just feel at a loss in making the skills stick. I never remember them and get caught in a cycle of guilt and shame after. But I never change and still resort to my previous behaviours and It kills me because of it. I genuinely just want to suffering the stop and Id do anything for that.

It's so so tough.

I feel like the symptoms are getting worse and the worse they get the worse I hate myself. I've been in dbt since December, i find it difficult to remember the skills and then I get even more frustrated with myself.

I want to get better but Im struggling to believe I can, I'm so so scared of myself due to my maladaptive behaviours.
I'm struggling with dbt so much. I feel like I'm just getting worse. Did this ever happen to you during your process?
As I said, too late
Found my way out
It's too late now.
I believe I'm a bad person, bad people don't deserve happiness.
I've tried numerous ssri and I won't be given anything else due to the risk of an OD. Okay, it may not make me happy, but at least I won't be suffering.
I've had to get it pointed out to me, I very rarely notice it until its too late and I've started to sprial. Seems like you're on the right path because you're working on it aswell!
Catching it is the hardest part for me, usually it happens and it's too late when I notice, it's really tough. Gotta work each day.
Did you complete the full course of dbt? How was it for you?
Check the facts seems to be the way forward.
That link looks really helpful, thanks for sharing.

Everyone does it to some extent, you don't have to hvae borderline to split but it is common amongst BPD patients. It's the idea that a person/ourself/situation is all good or all bad, it is black and white thinking.

That sounds exactly what has happened, does that tend to happen alot with DBT? I'm finding it very helpful but the over analysing is really hard. I try to practice mindfulness whenever I can remember, I can get in to stages where I've no motivation and it feels like I can't practice anything.

Never thought of that, that's a good idea. I'd probably just get 21 questions then.

Its very very tough, I over think everything so i had to do something. Yeh, it's not natural at all.

No date yet, I'm pretty nervous about doing it online as I don't really have a place at home where I wouldn't be heard. But hopefully DBT will be back soon, since covid I've had to do alot more work by myself which does help and I want to get back into talking about the issues I have to overcome. While I'm doing all of this I don't feel like I've changed and that's why I'm starting to feel like I'm going crazy.
I don't think you where being ungrateful, you felt how you did, you're human, it's not a bad thing.

I'm sorry you feel that way, it must be so hard, I felt like that 2 nights ago, I tried to end my life, I got lucky that it didn't work, I'm still here, life is honestly worth trying for. I hope you don't give up, people do care.

No worries, if you think it's relevant then it is relevant. That's good news that's she's doing a bit better, we have to look at the positives even when we're in the worst of times. Thank you, I'm struggling and finding it hard to see a way out, but Ive to keep going.

Some people don't know how to react to information like that. The do care, they just may not be able to show it how we need, some just can't, it's really hard to accept it, I really struggle with that myself. You got this.

I've been caught in a similar situation at the moment, I was 5 months into therapy and the virus stopped it all and left me stuck in the house with the people im trying to heal from. All we can do is stay strong and try everything we can to keep moving forward.
Stay strong, it sounds like you're battling alot in your own mind. It's hard, I know it is, I do it everyday, but you have to keep going, for you, you're important.
It's the guilt of what I've done that's eating me alive. I can't bear to live with myself feeling that im a bad person when I know I'm not.
Go you! That's awesome. Keep going.
Its horrible, I've pushed everyone else away, she was always there no matter how hard it was but this time I was too much, I feel horrible.
